# Frequently asked questions

#### Have more questions about pricing?    Contact us anytime at   [sales@sms-magic.com](mailto:sales@sms-magic.com)

What do I get in Multi-channel Messaging Plan?

The Multi-channel Messaging Plan for Salesforce CRM includes 12000 SMS Credits,
1 Multichannel License,
1 Virtual Phone Number,
1 WhatsApp Number,
5 Facebook Business Pages,
2000 shortened links for USA Annual Plan.


Benefits are CRM specific, country specific and plan specific.


You can buy additional multichannel licenses, virtual phone numbers and message credits for more messaging needs.

What do I get in SMS Conversational Plan ?

The SMS Conversational Plan for Salesforce CRM includes 6000 SMS Credits,
1 Conversational License,
1 Virtual Phone Number for USA Annual Plan.


Benefits are CRM specific, country specific and plan specific.


You can buy additional conversational licenses, virtual phone numbers and message credits for more messaging needs.

What do I get in SMS Automation Plan ?

The SMS Automation Plan for Salesforce CRM includes 3000 SMS Credits,
1 Automation License,
1 Virtual Phone Number for USA Annual Plan.


Benefits are CRM specific, country specific and plan specific.


You can buy additional automation licenses, virtual phone numbers and message credits for more messaging needs.

How do I build my own plan?

Based on your messaging needs, you can select CRM and Country on this page and click Create Plan under Build Your Own Plan. You get flexibility to choose number of licenses, credits, phone numbers, channels and more premium features as per your custom needs.

What are Virtual Phone Numbers?

Virtual Phone Numbers and Long codes are different names used for the numbers on which you receive messages, and from which you send messages. Virtual Phone Numbers and long codes are specific to countries. If you're messaging to and from different countries, you will need to have different numbers for those countries.
